Name: CreateTicket
Content:
declare @ticket varchar(32), @filename varchar(128), @description nvarchar(128), @compactMode char(1)
select @ticket = lower(replace(newid(),'-',''))
if exists(select 1 from options where name = 'm_compact_mode' and rtrim(val) = '1') select @compactMode = '1' else select @compactMode = '0'
if @@language = 'v' select @filename = case when @compactMode = '0' then 'WTDetail.xlsx' else 'WTDetail3.xlsx' end, @description = N'Phiếu xuất điều chuyển thực tế'
else select @filename = case when @compactMode = '0' then 'WTDetail2.xlsx' else 'WTDetail4.xlsx' end, @description = N'Goods Transfer'
insert into @@sysDatabaseName..ticket values(@ticket, @@userID, '&TransferID;', @filename, @description, '@@appDatabaseName', getdate());

Name: ScriptInsertRetrieveItems
Content:
<![CDATA[
function insert$Retrieve$Items(g, r1, z, r2, columns, c1, c2) {
  var a1 = (columns + (c1 ? ',' + c1 : '')).split(','), a2 = (columns + (c2 ? ',' + c2 : '')).split(',');
  for (var i = 0; i < a1.length; i++) {
    var l1 = g._getColumnOrder($func.trim(a1[i])), l2 = z._getColumnOrder($func.trim(a2[i]));
    if (l1 > 0 && l2 > 0) z._setItemValue(r2, l2, g._getItemValue(r1, l1));
  }
}
]]>

Name: ScriptEmptyExternalField
Content:
<![CDATA[
function set$Voucher$EmptyExternalField(g, s) {
  var a = s.split(',');
  for (var i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
    var l = g._getColumnOrder($func.trim(a[i]));
    for (var r = 0; r < g._rowCount; r++) {
      g._setItemValue(r + 1, l, null);
    }
  }
}
]]>

Name: DowloadScript
Content:
<![CDATA[
function request$Download(g, a) {
  g.request(g, 'Download', a, []);
  var r = $get('requestFormData');
  if (!r) r = $func.requestFormData();
  var query = '?a=1&t=' + ']]>&TransferID;<![CDATA[' + '&k=' + g._key;
  r.action = $func.resolveClientUrl('~/AppHandler/Transfer.ashx' + query, g._baseUrl);
  if (!$func.isIE) r.target = '_blank';
  r.submit();
  if (g._activeCell) g._activeCell.focus();
}
]]>

Name: XMLGetUOMConversion
Content:
<action id="UOM" ><text><![CDATA[
declare @rate numeric(16, 5)
if exists (select 1 from vdmvtqddvt where dvt = @dvt and (ma_vt = @ma_vt or ma_vt = '*')) begin
  select @rate = he_so from vdmvtqddvt where dvt = @dvt and (ma_vt = @ma_vt or ma_vt = '*')
  select isnull(@rate, 1) as he_so
  return
end
]]></text></action>

Name: XMLGetReason
Content:
<action id="Reason" ><text><![CDATA[
if exists(select 1 from dmnx a join dmtk b on a.tk = b.tk where a.ma_nx = @ma_nx and b.loai_tk = 1) begin
  select rtrim(tk) as tk from dmnx where ma_nx = @ma_nx
  return
end
]]></text></action>
